scenes.title_en: The Eight Steps and Importing Footage
scenes.context: 八步骤：思路、素材、初剪、精剪、加音乐、加文字、加音效、导出。导入素材点加号或拖拽到媒体池；剪辑前先定位主题。
sentences: 今天我们学剪映专业版的完整剪辑流程，八个步骤从零开始，让不会剪辑的你看完就能上手。
Today we learn the full JianYing Pro workflow — eight steps from zero, so non-editors can start right away.
the full workflow（完整流程）
你可以点击左侧的加号按钮进行导入，也可以直接从文件夹里把素材拖拽到媒体池的区域。
Tap the plus button on the left to import, or drag files straight from the folder into the media pool.
the media pool（媒体池）
一定要在心里有一个明确的思路，这个步骤很多新手会忽略掉，但恰恰对于入门剪辑的同学是最重要的。
Keep a clear concept in mind — beginners skip this step, yet it matters most when you're starting out.
a clear concept（明确的思路）
paraphrase: Decide what you're saying before you cut.
scenes.speak: Today we learn the full JianYing Pro workflow — eight steps from zero, so non-editors can start right away. Tap the plus button on the left to import, or drag files straight from the folder into the media pool. Keep a clear concept in mind — beginners skip this step, yet it matters most when you're starting out.

scenes.title_cn: 初剪：空镜开场与出入点
scenes.title_en: Rough Cut: Empty-Shot Openings and In-Out Points
scenes.context: 片头先放空镜头营造氛围，不直接放人物镜头。按I键入点、O键出点拖到时间线；同场景成组、异场景加空镜过渡；分离音频删除原声去杂音。
sentences: 剪辑的时候不要一上来就放人物镜头，直接进入主题，那节奏会太快，观众还没有进入状态可能就直接滑走了。
Don't start with a people shot and dive straight into the topic — the pace gets too fast and viewers swipe away before they settle in.
swipe away（滑走）
在片头我一般会选几个空镜头作为开场，营造氛围、调动观众情绪、增加一点点神秘感。
For the opening I usually pick a few empty shots to build atmosphere, stir emotion, and add a hint of mystery.
empty shots（空镜头）
先剪哪一段，按I键入点，按O键出点，然后直接拖到时间线。
To choose a section, press I for the in point and O for the out point, then drag it onto the timeline.
in point / out point（入点/出点）
scenes.speak: Don't start with a people shot and dive straight into the topic — the pace gets too fast and viewers swipe away before they settle in. For the opening I usually pick a few empty shots to build atmosphere, stir emotion, and add a hint of mystery. To choose a section, press I for the in point and O for the out point, then drag it onto the timeline.

scenes.title_en: Removing Original Audio and Timing the Music
scenes.context: 分离音频删除原声去掉杂音。音乐时机：通用先剪画面再加，踩点片先放音乐按节拍剪。界面可拖面板缝隙调整。
sentences: 选中所有的片段，鼠标右键选择分离音频，把分离出来的原声删掉，这样就可以去掉杂音了。
Select every clip, right-click to detach the audio, and delete the original sound to clear the noise.
detach the audio（分离音频）
比较通用的做法是先剪辑好画面、去掉原声、再加背景音乐。
The common approach is to cut the picture, remove the original audio, then add the background music.
background music（背景音乐）
如果你的片子是需要踩点，那就可以先把音乐放进来，再根据音乐的节拍去剪画面。
If your video needs beat-syncing, bring the music in first and cut the picture to its rhythm.
beat-syncing（踩点）
scenes.speak: Select every clip, right-click to detach the audio, and delete the original sound to clear the noise. The common approach is to cut the picture, remove the original audio, then add the background music. If your video needs beat-syncing, bring the music in first and cut the picture to its rhythm.

scenes.title_en: Fine Cut: Aligning Beats and Changing Speed
scenes.context: 素材拖到自由轨道逐段调整，Command+B分割、Delete删除，与音乐节奏点对齐。Command+R变速：人物0.25倍、空镜0.5倍，需120帧素材。
sentences: 把素材往上拖到自由轨道，然后往后挪一点，就能看到它和第一段素材之间流出了空隙。
Drag the clip up to a free track and nudge it back, and you'll see a gap open between it and the first clip.
a free track（自由轨道）
中间有一小段是我想要的，用Command加B把它分割出来，选中后面不需要的片段按Delete键删除。
A small middle section is what I want — split it out with Command+B, then select the rest and press Delete.
split it out（分割出来）
我们按Command加R打开变速控制，调整到0.25倍，整个片段降低了速度，氛围感一下子就出来了。
We hit Command+R for the speed control and set 0.25x — slowing the clip instantly brings out the mood.
the speed control（变速控制）
paraphrase: Line up with the musical beat.
scenes.speak: Drag the clip up to a free track and nudge it back, and you'll see a gap open between it and the first clip. A small middle section is what I want — split it out with Command+B, then select the rest and press Delete. We hit Command+R for the speed control and set 0.25x — slowing the clip instantly brings out the mood.

scenes.context: 智能文本识别歌词选排列样式。转场只加在不同场景之间，同组镜头不加；拖到时间线拉前后端调时长。
sentences: 我们可以通过左上方找到文本，然后点击智能文本，选择识别歌词。
Find Text on the top left, tap Smart Text, and choose to recognize lyrics.
recognize lyrics（识别歌词）
识别出来之后这里有非常多的歌词排列样式供我们选择。
After recognition there are plenty of lyric layouts to choose from.
lyric layouts（歌词排列样式）
像这样属于同一组镜头就不要刻意去加转场了，一定要加在不同场景之间。
Shots belonging to the same group don't need a transition — only add them between different scenes.
a transition（转场）
scenes.speak: Find Text on the top left, tap Smart Text, and choose to recognize lyrics. After recognition there are plenty of lyric layouts to choose from. Shots belonging to the same group don't need a transition — only add them between different scenes.

scenes.context: 音效根据画面联想（户外=知了/风/鸟叫），音量调小作点缀。导出：1080P/MP4/30帧。结语：手动练习才能记住。
sentences: 音效怎么加呢？根据画面来就行，在这个画面我们会联想到什么声音？知了的声音，风声鸟叫声，这些都符合画面的氛围。
How do you add sound effects? Just follow the picture — what sounds does this scene bring to mind? Cicadas, wind, birdsong — all match the mood.
follow the picture（根据画面）
我们这个音效只是点缀增加氛围感用的，不用太突出，所以这里我们把音量调小一点。
The SFX is only a garnish for atmosphere — it shouldn't stand out, so we turn the volume down.
a garnish（点缀）
视频分辨率我们选择1080P或者4K，一般选择1080P就够用了。
Pick 1080P or 4K for the resolution — 1080P is usually more than enough.
剪辑这个东西观看可能还不够，一定要自己手动练习一遍，才能真正记住。
Watching isn't enough for editing — you have to practice it by hand to really remember.
practice by hand（手动练习）
scenes.speak: How do you add sound effects? Just follow the picture — what sounds does this scene bring to mind? Cicadas, wind, birdsong — all match the mood. The SFX is only a garnish for atmosphere — it shouldn't stand out, so we turn the volume down. Pick 1080P or 4K for the resolution — 1080P is usually more than enough. Watching isn't enough for editing — you have to practice it by hand to really remember.

practice.a: The in point and out point.
The SFX is only a garnish.

pitfalls: Start with a people shot and dive straight in.
Open with empty shots to set the mood.
Too-fast openings make viewers swipe away.
Slow the footage without checking the frame rate.
Add transitions between every single clip.
Same-scene shots read as one group — transitions feel forced.
Sound should whisper atmosphere, not shout over the picture.
shifts: 看教程觉得都会，一上手就懵
八步流程练一遍：思路→素材→初剪→精剪→音乐→文字→音效→导出
difficult_words: Drag files into the media pool.
Keep a clear concept in mind.
Press I for the in point.
Drag the clip to a free track.
